name: Article 5, § 8 – 70
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Public interface connected to the Internal Market Information System for the declaration of posting of workers and amending Regulation (EU) No 1024/2012
part_text: 8. A Member State may allow the competent national authority to provide national social partners on which national law confers a role in monitoring compliance with posting rules by other means than IMI with relevant information available in IMI to the extent strictly necessary and exclusively for the purpose of checking compliance with posting rules and in accordance with national law and practices, provided that the information relates to a posting to the territory of the Member State concerned. That information shall be limited to the identity and contact details of the service provider and of its contact person, the number of posted workers, the address of the workplace and the anticipated duration of the posting. It shall not include any other personal data of posted workers and shall not be transmitted to third parties or processed for any other purpose. The competent national authority shall keep a record of each transmission and shall inform the service provider concerned.
